blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently achieved superhuman performance on several long-horizon benchmarks. However, their computational cost limits their use in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains such as video games. A key bottleneck is representing each screenshot as thousands of visual tokens, which accumulate into long contexts as agents reason over extended interaction histories. We observe that most of these visual tokens are either semantically irrelevant to the agent's next action or temporally redundant across screenshots. Building on this observation, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations that preserve the information needed for action prediction. In VTR, we train the vision-language model together with a lightweight spatio-temporal router that examines each image region in the current and previous screenshots and decides whether its visual token enters the language model. We optimize the router using an adaptive loss to keep the number of visual tokens as small as possible while minimizing performance degradation. With just 2,000 training steps, VTR matches the performance of the full-resolution model on OSWorld, CUA-World, and video game action prediction, while using 2.5-5.8x fewer visual tokens. These savings reduce inference cost by up to 3.3x and speed up prefill by up to 2.9x. VTR also outperforms lowering the image resolution and other baselines for dropping tokens, by up to 12.8 points on OSWorld. Overall, VTR enables computer-use agents to process only the visual tokens they need, allowing them to be used in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains at a fraction of the computational cost. Code and models are available at https://pranjal2041.github.io/vtr
blocks.zh: 计算机使用剂(CUAs)最近在若干长视基准上取得了超人性能. 然而,他们的计算成本限制了其在长视任务和电子游戏等实时领域的使用. 一个关键的瓶颈是将每个截图作为数千个视觉标志物来代表,这些标志物在长时间的语境中积累起来,作为代理商在扩展的互动历史中的理性. 我们观察到,大多数这些视觉符号要么与特工的下一个动作毫不相干,要么在截图上暂时多余. 基于这一观察,我们引入了Visual Token Routing(VTR),这是一个学习稀疏视觉表现的联合培训框架,保存行动预测所需的信息. 在VTR中,我们用轻量级的Spatio-时空路由器来训练视觉语言模型,该路由器检查当前和以往截图中的每个图像区域,并决定其视觉符号是否进入语言模型. 我们利用适应性损失来优化路由器,尽量保持视觉符号的数量,同时尽量减少性能退化. 只要2000个训练步骤,VTR就可以匹配OSWorld,CUA-World上全分辨率模型的性能以及电子游戏动作预测,同时使用2.5-5.8x更少的视觉符号. 这些节省使推论成本减少多达3.3x,加速预填达到2.9x. VTR在OSWorld上还比降低图像分辨率和其他投币基准的成绩高出12.8分. 总体而言,VTR使计算机使用代理能够只处理它们所需要的视觉信号,允许它们以一小部分的计算成本用于长视距任务和实时域. 守则和模型见https://pranjal2041.github.io/vtr。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Computer-use agents (CUAs), which operate software by observing screenshots and issuing mouse and keyboard actions, have recently achieved superhuman performance on several long-horizon benchmarks ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Aggarwal et al., 2026b ; Aggarwal et al., 2026a ) . However, their computational cost limits their use in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains such as video games ( Aggarwal et al., 2026a ; Abhyankar et al., 2026 ) . A key bottleneck is the representation of each screenshot as thousands of visual tokens, which accumulate into long contexts as agents reason over extended histories of interaction. For instance, Qwen3.5 ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) encodes a single 1080p screenshot into about 2,000 visual tokens, so an agent that keeps its full history on a 100-step task has over 200,000 visual tokens in its context by the final step. In video games, agents observe the screen many times per second, and even at a reduced resolution of 640 × 360 640\times 360 , one minute of play at 30 frames per second amounts to about 400,000 visual tokens. Furthermore, in real-time environments, speed is the primary bottleneck for frontier agents ( Aggarwal and Welleck, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 计算机使用代理(CUAs)通过观察截图和发布鼠标和键盘动作来操作软件,最近在一些长距离基准上取得了超人性能(Xie等,2024;Aggarwal等,2026b;Aggarwal等,2026a). 然而,他们的计算成本限制了其在长视任务和电子游戏等实时领域的使用(Aggarwal等,2026a;Abhyankar等,2026). 一个关键的瓶颈是每个截图作为上千个可视符号的表示,这些符号在长时间内积累起来,作为代理人理性地超越了互动的漫长历史. 例如: Quen3.5 (Quen Team, 2026 ) 将一首单曲 1080p 截图编码成约 2000 个可视化符号,因此,通过最后一步,在上下文中,一个保持其完整历史的代理在100步任务上拥有超过20万个可视化符号. 在电子游戏中,代理每秒多次观察屏幕,甚至以640×360640\times 360的减分辨率观察屏幕,每秒30帧的一分钟播放量相当于约40万个可视符号. 此外,在实时环境中,速度是边境人员的主要瓶颈(Aggarwal and Welleck,2026年)。

blocks.en: Existing methods reduce the number of visual tokens by keeping the tokens that receive the most attention within each image ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) , or by dropping tokens that remain unchanged across video frames ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Bagrov et al., 2025 ) . However, these hand-designed rules keep a fixed fraction of tokens or apply a fixed threshold to every input, regardless of what the agent needs for its next action. Other work learns which visual tokens to keep jointly with the model for single images in general visual question answering ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ) . However, computer-use agents face fundamentally new challenges, such as long histories of nearly identical screenshots, and actions that depend on small regions of the screen, like a cursor or a single spreadsheet cell.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过保留每个图像中最受关注的标志来减少可视化标志的数量(Chen等,2024;Yang等,2025;或通过丢弃在视频帧上保持不变的标志(Shen等,2025;Bagrov等,2025). 然而,这些由手工设计的规则保留了一定比例的符号,或者对每一项输入都适用了固定的阈值,不管代理人对其下一步行动需要什么. 其他作品学习了哪些视觉符号与一般视觉问答中的单相图像模型共同保存(黄等,2025;叶等,2025. 然而,计算机使用代理人面临着根本的新挑战,如截图几乎相同的漫长历史,以及依赖于屏幕小区域的行动,如光标或单一的电子表格单元格等.

blocks.en: We observe that most visual tokens in an agent’s history are either semantically irrelevant to its next action or temporally redundant across screenshots. For instance, the taskbar and the empty parts of a document rarely affect the agent’s next click, and consecutive game frames share most of their background. Building on this observation, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations that preserve the information needed for action prediction (§ 2 ; Figure 1 ). In VTR, a lightweight spatio-temporal router processes each image region across the current and previous screenshots and outputs a decision to keep the visual token or not. Dropped tokens are removed from the input sequence, so the language model processes only the kept tokens, which retain their original positional encodings.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,在特工历史上,大多数视觉标志要么与下一个行动毫不相干,要么在截图上暂时多余。 例如,任务栏和文档的空部分很少会影响代理机的下一次点击,而相继的游戏帧则分享大部分背景. 基于这一观察,我们引入了Visual Token Routing(VTR),这是一个学习稀有视觉表现的联合培训框架,保存行动预测所需的信息(§2;图1). 在VTR中,一个轻量级的spitio-textal路由器处理当前和以往截图所覆盖的每个图像区域,并输出是否保留可视符号的决定. 被丢弃的活符被从输入序列中去掉,因此语言模型只处理所保存活符,这些活符保留了原来的位置编码.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of Visual Token Routing (VTR). Spatio-temporal router: A lightweight router reads each image region across the current and previous screenshots and decides whether its visual token enters the language model. Zoomed-in region: While the agent types a file name into a save dialog in front of a playing video, the router keeps only the tokens of the typed file name. It drops the regions that did not change, and also drops the circled part of the video, which changed but is not relevant to the task.
blocks.zh: 图1:视觉Token Routing(VTR)概览. 时空路由器 : 一个轻量级的路由器读取了当前和之前截图所覆盖的每个图像区域,并决定其视觉符号是否进入了语言模型. 缩放区域 : 虽然代理在播放视频前将一个文件名打入保存对话框,但路由器只保留被打出文件名的符号. 它将没有改变的区域降下,同时也将盘旋部分的视频降下,视频虽有变化,但与任务无关.

blocks.en: We train the router jointly with the language model to satisfy two objectives: (1) keeping as few visual tokens as possible, and (2) preserving the model’s accuracy in predicting the agent’s next action. However, training the router poses two challenges. First, dropping a token is a discrete decision that provides no gradient to the router, which we address by scaling each kept token by its keep probability, as in mixture-of-experts models ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ) . Second, unlike mixture-of-experts models, where each token is processed by a fixed number of experts, the router must also decide how many tokens to keep. We therefore measure how much the screenshots help the model predict each action, using reference models trained with and without them, and adaptively weight the two objectives so that the model keeps this benefit while dropping tokens. In doing so, the router learns how many visual tokens each input needs while preserving the model’s performance, rather than relying on a fixed token budget.
blocks.zh: 我们与语言模型一起训练路由器,以满足两个目标:(1) 尽可能少地保留视觉符号;(2) 在预测代理人下一步行动时保持模型的准确性. 然而,培训路由器带来了两个挑战。 首先,投出一个符号是一个不向路由器提供梯度的离散决定,我们通过按其存取概率对每个符号进行缩放来解决,如在专家混合模型中(Shazeer等,2017;Fedus等,2022). 第二,与专家混合模型不同的是,每个符由固定数量的专家处理,路由器还必须决定要保存多少符. 因此,我们用经过训练的和没有这些模型的参照模型,衡量截图对模型预测每项行动有多大帮助,并适应性地衡量这两个目标,以便模型在降低符号的同时保持这一效益。 在这样做时,路由器会学习每个输入需要多少可视符号,同时保留模型的性能,而不是依赖固定的符号预算.

blocks.en: We use VTR to train vision-language models on computer-use trajectories and video game play, and evaluate them on OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , CUA-World ( Aggarwal et al., 2026b ) , and video game action prediction. With just 2,000 training steps, VTR matches the performance of the full-resolution model in all three domains, while using 2.5-5.8 × \times fewer visual tokens (Figure 4 ). These savings reduce inference cost by up to 3.3 × \times and speed up prefill by up to 2.9 × \times (Figure 5 ). In addition, VTR outperforms lowering the image resolution and hand-designed rules for dropping tokens, by up to 12.8 points on OSWorld. Furthermore, we find that learning visual token selection jointly with the model is crucial, improving performance by 13.2 points on OSWorld over the same router trained separately from the model.
blocks.zh: 我们使用VTR来培训计算机使用轨迹和电子游戏游戏的视觉语言模型,并在OSWorld(Xie等,2024),CUA-World(Aggarwal等,2026b),以及电子游戏动作预测上评价. 仅用2000个训练步骤,VTR就匹配了全部三个域的全分辨率模型的性能,同时使用2.5-5.8×\times较少的可视符号(图4). 这些节省使推断费用减少3.3xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 此外,VTR在OSWorld上比降下图像分辨率和手设计降出令牌的规则要高12.8分. 此外,我们发现,与模型一起学习视觉符号选择至关重要,在OSWorld上通过与模型分开培训的同一路由器提高13.2分的性能。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are three-fold. First, we introduce Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework for learning sparse visual representations, in which a lightweight spatio-temporal router decides which visual tokens enter the language model. Second, we propose a dual objective that trains the router to keep as few visual tokens as possible while preserving action prediction, so that the router learns how many visual tokens each input needs without a fixed token budget. Third, through extensive evaluations, we show that VTR matches full-resolution performance on OSWorld, CUA-World, and video game action prediction with 2.5-5.8 × \times fewer visual tokens and up to 3.3 × \times lower inference cost, that it outperforms other token reduction approaches, and that learning visual token selection jointly with the model is crucial.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献有三重。 首先,我们引入了Visual Token Routing(VTR),这是一个学习稀有视觉表现的联合培训框架,其中轻量级的斯皮提奥-时空路由器决定了哪些视觉符号进入了语言模型. 其次,我们提出一个双重目标,在保留动作预测的同时,训练路由器尽可能地保留较少的可视化符号,这样路由器就可以在没有固定的会标预算的情况下学习每个输入需要多少可视化符号. 第三,通过广泛的评价,我们显示VTR在OSWorld,CUA-World上与全分辨率的性能相匹配,以及电子游戏动作预测与2.5-5.8相匹配,视觉符号减少,推断成本降低至3.3相匹配,它比其他符号还低,与模型一起学习视觉符号选择至关重要.

blocks.en: We group observations into blocks of B B consecutive observations and call the first observation of each block an anchor (Figure 2 ). Anchors are kept in full, and the router acts only on the other observations in a block, with its history starting at the anchor. The anchor gives the model a full view of the screen to compare later observations against, and each new block refreshes this view, so regions that the router keeps dropping are never out of date for long.
blocks.zh: 我们把观测分为B连续观测的区块,并将每个区块的第一次观测称为锚(图2)。 锚地完全保存,路由器只在一区块中的其他观测上作用,其历史起于锚地. 主播给模型一个完整的屏幕视图来比较后期的观测结果,每个新块都会刷新这个视图,因此路由器不断掉落的区域永远不会长时间过时.

blocks.en: We also consider a sliding variant, in which only the first observation is kept in full, and the router’s history is a rolling window of the K K previous observations without block boundaries. This variant avoids the cost of periodic anchors and uses the same trained router.
blocks.zh: 我们还考虑一种滑动变体,其中只保留了第一个观测的完整,路由器的历史是K先前观测的滚动窗口,没有块界限. 此变体可避免周期锚的成本,并使用同一训练有素的路由器.

This raises two questions: how to measure ℒ deg \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{deg}} , and how to set λ \lambda . For the first question, the loss of π θ \pi_{\theta} alone is not enough, since some actions are hard to predict even from the full history, and others can be predicted from the anchors alone. We therefore compare π θ \pi_{\theta} against two reference models: one that sees the full history and one that sees only the anchors. For the second question, the right λ \lambda is unknown in advance, since a large λ \lambda keeps too many tokens and a small λ \lambda loses too much accuracy. We therefore set a target for how much accuracy the router may give up, measured as a fraction of how much the full history improves over the anchors alone, and adapt λ \lambda during training to meet it.

blocks.en: Since π θ \pi_{\theta} was pre-trained on full images, we train it jointly with the router so that it learns to predict actions from the kept tokens alone. At each training step, we sample gates for each example and update π θ \pi_{\theta} and the router with the cross-entropy loss of π θ \pi_{\theta} given only the kept tokens. We then sample a second set of gates and update only the router with Eq. ( 4 ), keeping π θ \pi_{\theta} fixed. The full and blind models are initialized from the same model as π θ \pi_{\theta} and trained with the cross-entropy loss on the same examples, so that i n i_{n} and d n d_{n} reflect differences in the input rather than in training. At inference, we use only π θ \pi_{\theta} and the router, so the reference models add no cost.

In joint training, the router learns which tokens matter only through the loss of π θ \pi_{\theta} , which gives a weak signal when the router starts from random weights. We therefore first train the router alone to predict simple labels based on § 1 : a token is labeled as kept only if its region changed from the previous observation, so that it is not temporally redundant, and belongs to an object segmented by SAM ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) , so that it is likely semantically relevant. Joint training then starts from this router and refines its decisions based on what the agent needs for its next action. Further details are in Appendix A.3 .

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate VTR in two domains: computer-use tasks and video games.
blocks.zh: 我们从两个方面评价VTR:计算机使用任务和电子游戏.

blocks.en: We apply VTR to Qwen3.5-2B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) . We train a single model on both desktop tasks and video games, and evaluate it in both domains. The router is a three-layer MLP with 23.3M parameters, about 1% of the size of the language model, which reads each image region across the current and K = 10 K=10 previous observations. We place an anchor every B = 10 B=10 observations, and set the target r ⋆ = 0.1 r^{\star}=0.1 (§ 2.3 ). Further details are in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: 将 VTR 应用到 Quen3.5-2B (Quen Team, 2026) (中文(简体) ). 我们在桌面任务和电子游戏上训练一个单一的模型,并在这两个领域进行评价。 路由器是一个有23.3M参数的三层MLP,大约为语言模型大小的1%,它读取了横跨当前和K=10K=10之前观测的每个图像区域. 设定目标 r = 0.1 r^{\star}=0.1 (§ 2.3). 详情见附录A。

We evaluate the agent on OSWorld ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , which contains tasks in common desktop applications such as web browsers and office software, and on CUA-World ( Aggarwal et al., 2026b ) , which contains tasks across 200 professional software applications.
blocks.zh: 我们从CUA-World列车进行计算机使用轨迹的训练,其中每个截图的分辨率为1920×1080 1920\times 1080,给出了2,040个视觉符号. 我们评价了OSWorld(Xie等,2024年)的代理商,其中包含网络浏览器和办公室软件等常见桌面应用中的任务,以及CUA-World(Aggarwal等,2026b)的代理商,其中包含了200个专业软件应用中的任务.

We evaluate how accurately the agent predicts the next action, such as a click or a key press, on held-out recordings from 36 games.

blocks.en: We compare VTR with the following ways to reduce visual tokens, all using the same model and training data: 1. Lower resolution: the dense model, which processes every visual token, with each image resized to 50%, 25%, or 12.5% of its area. 2. Pixel-diff: keeps only the regions whose pixels changed from the previous observation, following methods that drop tokens repeated across video frames ( Choudhury et al., 2024 ; Bagrov et al., 2025 ) and screenshots ( Abaskohi et al., 2026 ) . 3. H.264: keeps only the regions that the H.264 video codec ( Wiegand et al., 2003 ) encodes as moved or changed, following methods that select visual tokens from the motion vectors and residuals of video codecs ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Sarkar et al., 2026 ) . 4. Frozen router: the initial router of VTR, kept fixed while training the model, which shows the effect of training the router jointly with the model.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Main Results
blocks.zh: 4.1 主要成果

blocks.en: Figure 4: VTR matches full-resolution performance with far fewer visual tokens. Score on OSWorld (left), average score on CUA-World (middle), and click accuracy in video games (right), against visual tokens per image. The dashed line marks the dense model at full resolution.
blocks.zh: 图4:VTR与全分辨率性能相匹配,可视化符号要少得多. 在OSWorld(左)上得分,在CUA-World(中)上平均得分,并点击电子游戏中的准确度(右),相对每个图像的视觉符号. 虚线以完全分辨率标出密度模型.

blocks.en: Figure 4 compares VTR with the dense model, which processes every visual token, across numbers of tokens per image. On OSWorld and CUA-World, VTR matches the dense model at full resolution while using 2.5 × \times and 2.9 × \times fewer visual tokens, and in video games, it uses 5.8 × \times fewer. Interestingly, the same router keeps about 40% of the tokens on OSWorld but only 17% in video games. Since we never specify how many tokens to keep (§ 2.3 ), the router learns this difference on its own, likely because consecutive game frames are only 1/30 of a second apart, while desktop screenshots are taken after each action. These results show that most visual tokens in an agent’s history can be removed without degrading its actions, and that the router adapts how many it removes to the input.
blocks.zh: 图4比较了VTR与密集模型,该模型处理每个可视符号,跨出每个图像的符数. 在OSWorld和CUA-World上,VTR在使用2.5×\times和2.9×\tims较少可视化符号的同时,在全分辨率下与稠密模型相匹配,在电子游戏中,它使用5.8×\tims较少. 有趣的是,同一路由器在OSWorld上保留了约40%的代币,但在电子游戏中仅保留了17%. 由于我们从未指定要保存多少个令牌(§ 2.3),路由器会自己学习这种差异,可能是因为相接的游戏帧相隔一秒就只有1/30,而桌面截图则在每次动作后进行. 这些结果表明,一个代理商历史上的大多数可视符号都可以被去除而不会贬低其行为,而路由器则会调整其去除多少个以适应输入.

blocks.en: Figure 4 also compares VTR with two other ways to reduce visual tokens: lowering the image resolution, and hand-designed rules that keep the regions that changed between observations, namely pixel-diff and H.264. At every number of tokens where both are measured, VTR achieves higher performance than the dense model at a lower resolution. For instance, on OSWorld, VTR scores 2.9 points higher than the dense model at half the image area, while using fewer tokens. Lowering the resolution removes detail from every region of the screen, including the small regions that actions depend on, like a cursor or a spreadsheet cell, whereas VTR keeps the regions it selects at full resolution. VTR also outperforms both hand-designed rules on every benchmark. On OSWorld, for instance, VTR scores 18.1, compared with 9.4 for H.264 and 5.3 for pixel-diff. Unlike these rules, which decide what to keep from the pixels alone, VTR learns what the agent needs for its next action in each domain. Moreover, VTR is complementary to lowering the resolution: combined with a quarter of the image area, it reduces visual tokens by 23 × \times in video games, with only a small drop in click accuracy. These results show that learning which regions to keep preserves more of what the agent needs than lowering the resolution or applying a fixed rule.
blocks.zh: 图4还比较了VTR和减少视觉符号的另外两种方法:降低图像分辨率,以及手设计规则,将观测之间变化的区域,即像素-diff和H.264. 在对两者进行测量的每一个符号中,VTR在更低的分辨率下比密集的模型实现更高的性能. 例如,在OSWorld上,VTR在图像区域的一半上比密集模型高2.9分,同时使用更少的符号. 降低分辨率可以去除屏幕每个区域的细节,包括动作所依赖的小区域,如光标或电子表格单元格,而VTR则保持它所选择的区域的完全分辨率. VTR还超越了每个基准的手工设计规则. 例如,在OSWorld上,VTR得分为18.1分,而H.264的得分为9.4分,像素-diff的得分为5.3分. 与这些规则决定了什么是远离像素的单独规则不同,VTR学习了代理在每一个域的下个动作需要什么. 此外,VTR对降低分辨率起到补充作用:结合四分之一的图像区域,在电子游戏中将可视化符号减少23×\时,点击精度也只有小幅下降. 这些结果表明,了解哪些区域可以保留代理人所需要的东西,而不是降低分辨率或适用固定规则。

blocks.en: To isolate the effect of joint training, we compare VTR with a frozen router, which starts from the same initial router (§ 2.3 ) but keeps it fixed while training the language model. On OSWorld, VTR scores 18.1, compared with only 4.9 for the frozen router, which performs similarly to pixel-diff. This is expected, since the initial router is trained on a similar rule, keeping regions that changed and belong to an object, and training the language model alone cannot recover the regions that this router drops. In video games, VTR also achieves higher click accuracy than the frozen router, although the gap is smaller. These results show that the advantage of VTR comes from training the router jointly with the model, rather than from the initial rule.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离联合训练的效果,我们比较了VTR和被冻结的路由器,它从同一个初始路由器(§ 2.3)开始,但在训练语言模型时保持固定. 在OSWorld上,VTR得分为18.1分,而被冻结的路由器只有4.9分,其性能与像素-diff类似. 由于最初的路由器受到类似规则的训练,因此预计会这样,保留被改变和属于一个对象的区域,仅培训语言模型无法恢复这个路由器所掉落的区域. 在电子游戏中,VTR也实现了比被冻结的路由器更高的点击精度,尽管缺口较小. 这些结果表明,VTR的优势来自于与模型联合训练路由器,而不是从初始规则.

blocks.en: 4.2 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.2 分析

blocks.en: Figure 5: VTR makes inference cheaper and faster. Score on OSWorld (left), average score on CUA-World (middle), and click accuracy in video games (right), against inference cost relative to the dense model at full resolution (top) and prefill time per step (bottom). The dashed line marks the dense model at full resolution.
blocks.zh: 图5:VTR使推论更便宜更快. 在OSWorld(左)上得分,在CUA-World(中)上得分平均分,并点击电子游戏中的准确度(右),相对于完全分辨率(上)和每步(下)前填充时间的密集模型的推论成本. 虚线以完全分辨率标出密度模型.

blocks.en: Since VTR removes most visual tokens, each step of the agent also costs less and takes less time. Figure 5 shows the performance of each method against its inference cost and its prefill time, the time the model takes to process its input before generating an action. VTR reduces the cost by 2.4 × \times on OSWorld, 1.8 × \times on CUA-World, and 3.3 × \times in video games, and speeds up prefill by 2.3 × \times , 2.2 × \times , and 2.9 × \times . These gains are smaller than the reduction in visual tokens, since VTR removes only visual tokens, while the instruction, the previous actions, and the generated action stay the same. Moreover, VTR is both cheaper and faster than the dense model at half the image area in all three domains, while achieving higher performance. These results show that the token savings of VTR translate into lower cost and faster inference, while matching full-resolution performance.
blocks.zh: 由于VTR移除了大多数可视符号,代理的每个步骤也成本更低,花费的时间也更少. 图5显示每一种方法的性能与推论成本和预填时间,模型在产生动作前处理其投入所需的时间. VTR在OSWorld上将成本降低2.4×分,在CUA-World上降低1.8×分,在电子游戏中降低3.3×分,并加速了2.3×分,2.2×分和2.9分的预填. 这些增益比视觉符号的减少要小,因为VTR只去掉视觉符号,而指令,前作和所生成的动作则保持不变. 此外,VTR比所有三个域中图像区域的一半的密集模型既便宜又快,同时实现更高的性能. 这些结果表明,VTR的象征性节省转化为更低的成本和更快的推论,同时匹配了全分辨率的性能.

blocks.en: Figure 6: VTR adapts how many visual tokens it keeps to each domain and game. Percentage of visual tokens kept by each method on desktop tasks and on video games grouped by how much of the screen changes between consecutive frames.
blocks.zh: 图6:VTR调整了它在每个域和游戏中保留了多少可视符号. 在桌面任务和按屏幕在相继帧之间变化多少分类的电子游戏中,每种方法保存的可视化符号的百分比。

blocks.en: Since we never fix the number of kept tokens (§ 2.3 ), the router decides how many tokens each input needs. To see how this number varies, we group the video games by how much of the screen changes between consecutive frames, from games like Candy Crush, where little of the screen moves, to games like Counter-Strike 2, where most of it does. Figure 6 shows the percentage of visual tokens each method keeps. VTR keeps 2.7% of the tokens in games with low motion, 5.9% in games with high motion, and 26.3% on desktop tasks. Interestingly, as more of a game screen changes, VTR keeps only a few more tokens, while pixel-diff and H.264 keep many more. This is likely because many regions that change, such as the background moving as the camera turns, do not affect the agent’s next action. On desktop tasks, in contrast, VTR keeps more tokens than pixel-diff, likely because the agent often needs regions that did not change, such as text it has to read. These results show that VTR decides how many visual tokens to keep based on what each input needs, rather than on how much of the screen changes.
blocks.zh: 由于我们从来没有固定保存的符号数量(§ 2.3),路由器决定每个输入需要多少符号. 要了解这个数字是如何变化的,我们按连续帧间屏幕变化的多少来分组电子游戏,从屏幕很少移动的Candy Crush等游戏,到像Counter-Strike 2这样的游戏,大部分情况下都是如此. 图6显示每种方法所保存的视觉标志的百分比。 VTR在动作低的游戏中保留了2.7%的代币,在动作高的游戏中保留了5.9%的代币,在桌面任务中保留了26.3%的代币. 有趣的是,随着更多游戏屏幕的改变,VTR只保留了多几个令牌,而像素-diff和H.264则保留了多多. 这可能是因为许多变化的区域,如相机转来转去的背景,不会影响代理商的下一个动作. 在桌面任务上,相形之下,VTR保存了比像素-diff更多的符号,很可能是因为代理经常需要没有变化的区域,比如它必须读取的文本. 这些结果显示,VTR根据每个输入需要多少来决定要保留多少可视符号,而不是根据屏幕的多少变化来决定.

blocks.en: Figure 7: VTR keeps only the regions that the agent needs. The previous observation (top) and the current observation with the regions that VTR drops dimmed (bottom), in three video games and a desktop application.
blocks.zh: 图7:VTR只保留制剂需要的区域. 之前的观测(上)和当前对VTR在3个电子游戏和一个桌面应用程序中被降入暗(下)的区域的观测.

blocks.en: To see which regions the router keeps, Figure 7 shows the previous observation and the regions that VTR keeps in the current one. In Dota 2, a fight takes place on an otherwise static map, and VTR keeps 23 of the 220 regions, mostly the fighting units and their health bars. In Candy Crush, the player moves a single candy, and VTR keeps only the region of that candy. In Minecraft, VTR keeps the opponent and the health counter that dropped from 13 to 11, and drops the field around them. Interestingly, in Gpredict, VTR keeps the region where a tooltip disappeared, so it also treats the removal of an element as information, while it drops the satellite map behind the dialog. VTR also keeps a few isolated regions in static areas, likely because each gate is sampled from its keep probability. Overall, rather than just detecting motion, the router appears to keep the changes that the model cannot infer from earlier observations, such as a lower health counter or a closed tooltip, and to drop those it can, such as the shifted background when the camera moves in GTA V (Appendix B.1 ). Further examples are in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 要查看路由器所保存的哪个区域,图7显示了之前的观测结果以及VTR当前保存的区域. 在"多塔2"中,一场战斗在原本静止的地图上进行,而VTR保留了220个区域中的23个,大部分是战斗单位及其卫生棒. 在Candy Crush中,玩家会移动一粒单一的糖果,而VTR只保留了那个糖果的区域. 在"Minecraft"中,VTR将对手和从13降至11的保健计数器保留下来,并放弃了周围的球场. 有趣的是,在Gpredict中,VTR保留了一个工具提示消失的区域,因此它也将去除一个元素作为信息处理,同时将卫星地图放在了对话框后. VTR还保留了静态区域内的几个相隔区域,可能是因为每个门都从其保持概率中取样. 总的来说,路由器并不只是检测到运动,它似乎保留了模型无法从早期的观察中推断出来的改变,如较低的健康计数器或闭合工具提示,并放下它能够做的改变,如相机在GTA V中移动时的背景变化(Appendix B.1 . 其他例子见附录B.1。

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Many methods reduce the visual tokens of vision-language models without training, by keeping the tokens that receive the most attention ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) , merging similar tokens ( Bolya et al., 2023 ; Shang et al., 2025 ) , or dropping tokens that repeat across video frames, detected from pixels or from video codecs ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Bagrov et al., 2025 ; Choudhury et al., 2024 ; Tang et al., 2026 ; Sarkar et al., 2026 ) . Other methods train a module that predicts which tokens to keep ( Rao et al., 2021 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . However, all of these methods set the number of kept tokens in advance, as a fixed ratio, a fixed threshold, or a target token count. In contrast, VTR trains its router jointly with the language model and keeps as many tokens as the model needs to preserve its accuracy.
blocks.zh: 许多方法通过保留最受关注的标志来减少视觉语言模型的视觉标志(Chen等,2024;Yang等,2025;Zhang等,2025b),合并了类似的标志. (Bolya等,2023;Shang等,2025),或从像素或视频编码器中检测到的跨视频框重复的投放活物(Shen等,2025;Bagrov等,2025;Choudhury等,2024;Tang等,2026;Sarkar等,2026)。 其他方法培训一个模块,以预测要保存的标志(Rao等,2021;Huang等,2025;Ye等,2025;Wang等,2026a)。 然而,所有这些方法都预先设定了所保存的令牌的数量,作为固定比例,固定阈值,或目标令牌计数. 相形之下,VTR与语言模型一起训练其路由器,并保留了与模型需要保持准确性一样多的符号.

blocks.en: Computer-use agents take far longer than humans to complete tasks ( Abhyankar et al., 2026 ; Aggarwal et al., 2026a ) , and latency limits them in real-time domains such as video games ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Aggarwal and Welleck, 2026 ) . To reduce the cost of screenshots, agents commonly keep only the last few screenshots in context ( Qin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Anthropic, 2026 ) , and methods designed for GUI agents skip, prune, or compress visual tokens ( Lin et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Abaskohi et al., 2026 ) . However, these methods either discard older screenshots entirely, or decide what to drop with fixed rules or a selector trained separately from the model that predicts actions. In contrast, VTR learns which tokens to keep together with the model, based on what the agent needs for its next action.
blocks.zh: 计算机使用剂比人类需要更长的时间来完成任务(Abhyankar等,2026;Aggarwal等,2026a),而潜伏性限制了其在电子游戏等实时领域(Zhang等,2025a;Aggarwal和Welleck,2026). 为降低截图成本,特工通常只保留最后几张截图的背景(秦等,2025;王等,2025a;Anthropic,2026;),以及为GUI代理设计的方法跳出,放出或压缩视觉标志(林等,2025;徐等,2026;黄等,2026;陈等,2025;王等,2026b;阿巴斯科希等,2026.). 然而,这些方法要么完全抛弃了更古老的截图,要么决定用固定规则降下什么,要么选择一个与预测动作的模型分开训练的选取者. 反之,VTR根据代理对其下一步行动的需求,学习了哪些符号能与模型保持一致.

blocks.en: Mixture-of-experts and Mixture-of-Depths models learn to route tokens through parts of the network ( Shazeer et al., 2017 ; Fedus et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Raposo et al., 2024 ) , and adaptive computation methods let the amount of computation vary across inputs ( Graves, 2016 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Schuster et al., 2022 ) . Separately, constrained optimization adapts a Lagrange multiplier during training to meet a target, for example in VAEs, reinforcement learning, and pruning ( Rezende and Viola, 2018 ; Tessler et al., 2019 ; Wang et al., 2020 ; Gallego-Posada et al., 2022 ) . However, these methods fix the amount of computation, set a target for it, or calibrate it only after training, rather than constraining the model to keep its accuracy during training. In contrast, VTR minimizes the number of kept tokens subject to the model not losing accuracy, and enforces this constraint during training by dual ascent. Appendix C provides an extended discussion of related work.
blocks.zh: 专家混合和深度混合模型学习通过网络部分路由符(Shazeer等,2017;Fedus等,2022;Zhou等,2022;Raposo等,2024;适应性计算方法允许不同投入的计算量有所不同(Graves等,2016;Wang等,2025b;Schuster等,2022)。 另外,受限优化在训练期间会调整拉格兰克乘数,以达到一个目标,例如在VAEs,强化学习和普跑(Rezende and Viola,2018;Tessler等,2019;Wang等,2020;Gallego-Posada等,2022). 然而,这些方法固定了计算数量,为其设定了目标,或者只在训练后校正,而不是在训练期间限制模型保持准确性. 相形之下,VTR将受模型约束的被保存的令牌数量最小化而不会失去准确性,并在训练期间通过双升来强制实施这一约束. 附 录 C对相关工作进行了广泛的讨论。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced Visual Token Routing (VTR), a joint training framework that enables computer-use agents to process only the visual tokens they need. By training a lightweight spatio-temporal router together with the vision-language model to keep as few visual tokens as possible without losing accuracy, VTR addresses a key computational bottleneck of computer-use agents, which arises from representing each screenshot with thousands of visual tokens. VTR matches the performance of the full-resolution model on OSWorld, CUA-World, and video game action prediction with 2.5-5.8 × \times fewer visual tokens, reducing inference cost by up to 3.3 × \times and speeding up prefill by up to 2.9 × \times , and outperforms lowering the image resolution and other baselines for dropping tokens. We further show that learning which tokens to keep jointly with the model is crucial. Our analysis also shows that the router learns on its own how many tokens to keep for each input and domain, keeping only regions that matter for the agent’s next action. By learning what an agent needs to see, VTR makes it possible to use computer-use agents in long-horizon tasks and real-time domains at a fraction of the computational cost.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了Visual Token Routing(VTR),这是一个联合培训框架,它使计算机使用代理人能够只处理他们需要的视觉标志. VTR通过训练轻量级的斯皮提奥-时相路由器与视觉语言模型一起尽可能少地保存可视化符号而不致失去准确性,解决了计算机使用代理的关键计算瓶颈,这出自于以上千可视化符号代表每个截图. VTR与OSWorld,CUA-World上的全分辨率模型以及电子游戏动作预测的性能相匹配,2.5-5.8 ×\times的可视信号减少,推论成本减少可达3.3×x\tims,并加速预填最多可达2.9×x\tims,并且优于降低图像分辨率和其他投放信号的基线. 我们进一步表明,学习哪些象征与模式相结合是至关重要的。 我们的分析还表明,路由器自己学习了每个输入和域要保存多少个符号,只保留了对代理人下一步行动重要的区域. 通过了解一个代理需要看到什么,VTR使得在长距离任务和实时域中使用计算机使用代理成为可能,其成本是计算成本的一小部分.

blocks.en: Appendix A Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录A 实验细节

blocks.en: A.1 Training Data
blocks.zh: A.1 培训数据

blocks.en: The training data contains 4,265 computer-use examples from the CUA-World training split [ Aggarwal et al., 2026b ] and 29,401 video game examples from the markov-ai/gaming-500-hours dataset, and we sample computer-use and video game examples at a ratio of 1:3. Each example contains up to 20 screenshots for computer use and 40 frames for video games, with older steps given as text, and we compute the cross-entropy loss on every token of the target action.
blocks.zh: 培训数据包含来自CUA-World训练的4,265个计算机使用实例[Aggarwal等,2026b]和来自markov-ai/gaming-500小时数据集的29,401个电子游戏实例,我们以1:3的比例对计算机使用和电子游戏实例进行抽样. 每个例子都包含最多20个用于计算机的截图和40个用于电子游戏的帧,更古老的台阶给出为文本,我们计算目标动作的每个符号上的交叉通向损失.

blocks.en: A.2 Router Architecture
blocks.zh: A.2 路由器结构

blocks.en: The router’s input concatenates the visual tokens of K + 1 = 11 K+1=11 observations, which gives 11 × 2,048 = 22,528 11\times 2{,}048=22{,}528 dimensions. The MLP has layers of size 22,528, 1,024, 256, and 1, with GELU activations and a dropout of 0.1, for a total of 23.3M parameters. Requests with a single observation are kept in full.
blocks.zh: 路由器的输入调和了K+1=11 K+1=11个观测的视觉符号,给出了11×2,048=22,528 11\times 2{,}048=22{,}528个维度. MLP有尺寸为22,528,1,024,256和1的地层,GELU活化并退出0.1,共23.3M参数. 附有一项意见的请求全部保留。

blocks.en: A.3 Initialization
blocks.zh: A.3 初始化

blocks.en: For the initialization labels (§ 2.3 ), a region counts as changed if its mean absolute pixel change from the previous observation is at least 10 out of 255. We train on windows of 11 observations and supervise only the last one, using 47,489 computer-use windows and 29,709 video game windows. We train the router with a binary cross-entropy loss for 558 steps, with a batch size of 1,024 and AdamW with a learning rate of 1.5 × 10 − 3 1.5\times 10^{-3} .
blocks.zh: 对于初始化标签(§ 2.3),如果一个区域的平均值绝对像素与先前的观测值相差至少为255个中的10个,则该区域算作已改变. 我们用11个观察窗口进行训练,只监督最后一个,使用47 489个计算机使用窗口和29 709个电子游戏窗口。 我们训练的路由器有558步的二进制横断,分批大小为1,024和AdamW,学习速度为1.5×10−3 1.5\times 10×-3}.

blocks.en: A.4 Joint Training
blocks.zh: A.4 联合培训

blocks.en: Table 1 lists the hyperparameters for joint training. The full and blind models each have their own AdamW optimizer, and the visual tokens of each example are computed once and shared by all three models. For the adaptive weight, we use a 10 times larger step size when r ¯ \bar{r} is below r ⋆ r^{\star} , so that λ \lambda decreases quickly and the router resumes dropping tokens.
blocks.zh: 表1列出了联合培训的超参数。 完整的和盲的模型各有各自的亚当W优化器,每个例子的视觉符号都是一次性计算,所有三个模型都共享. 对于适应性重量,当 r\bar{r} 在 r\\ star} 下方时, 我们使用一个 10 倍大的步长, 这样\ lambda 迅速减少, 路由器恢复 降出符号 。

blocks.en: Table 1: Hyperparameters for joint training.
blocks.zh: 表1:联合培训的超参数。

blocks.en: A.5 Baselines
blocks.zh: A.5 基线

blocks.en: The dense, pixel-diff, and H.264 baselines are evaluated after 1,000 training steps, and the frozen router after 2,000.
blocks.zh: 密集,像素-diff,和H.264的基线在1000个训练步骤后进行评估,被冻结的路由器在2000个之后进行评估.

blocks.en: Images are resized to 100%, 50%, 25%, and 12.5% of their area, which gives 2,040, 1,008, 510, and 252 visual tokens per screenshot, and 220, 112, 55, and 28 per game frame.

blocks.en: Vision-language models represent each image with hundreds to thousands of visual tokens, and a large body of work reduces this number to speed up inference. Training-free methods score tokens by attention, either inside the language model, as FastV [ Chen et al., 2024 ] does after its second layer, or in the vision encoder, as VisionZip [ Yang et al., 2025 ] does, while SparseVLM [ Zhang et al., 2025b ] scores visual tokens by the attention they receive from the relevant text tokens. Token merging combines similar tokens instead of dropping them, first in vision transformers [ Bolya et al., 2023 ] and then in vision-language models, where LLaVA-PruMerge [ Shang et al., 2025 ] also chooses the number of kept tokens for each image with an outlier rule on attention scores. For video, methods exploit redundancy across frames: LongVU [ Shen et al., 2025 ] drops near-duplicate frames and reduces tokens based on their similarity across frames, EVS [ Bagrov et al., 2025 ] removes patches that stay the same across consecutive frames while keeping the positions of the remaining tokens, and run-length tokenization [ Choudhury et al., 2024 ] replaces patches that repeat over time with a single token. Codec-based methods instead read the motion vectors and residuals that video codecs already compute: OneVision-Encoder [ Tang et al., 2026 ] selects the patches with the strongest motion and residuals across frames, up to a fixed token budget, and trains its vision encoder on these sparse inputs, while CoPE-VideoLM [ Sarkar et al., 2026 ] encodes only keyframes with the image encoder and represents the other frames with a few tokens built from motion vectors and residuals. Learned methods train a module that predicts which tokens to keep together with the model, starting with DynamicViT [ Rao et al., 2021 ] for image classification and extending to vision-language models with Dynamic-LLaVA [ Huang et al., 2025 ] and ATP-LLaVA [ Ye et al., 2025 ] , while VideoLLM-MoD [ Wu et al., 2024 ] learns which video tokens skip the computation of each layer. However, in all of these methods, the number of kept tokens is set by hand: training-free methods use a fixed ratio or threshold, codec-based methods use a fixed token budget or keyframe density, DynamicViT and Dynamic-LLaVA add a loss that pulls the kept fraction toward a pre-defined keep rate, ATP-LLaVA pulls the average number of kept tokens toward a target count, and VideoLLM-MoD skips a fixed fraction of tokens. Moreover, apart from the video methods, they decide for each image independently. SCORE [ Wang et al., 2026a ] comes closest to our work. A small MLP reads each video token together with its change since the previous frame and outputs a keep probability, and the MLP is trained with reinforcement learning on sampled keep masks. However, SCORE keeps the vision encoder and the language model frozen, looks only one frame back, and keeps a fixed fraction of tokens at inference by selecting the highest-scoring ones. In contrast, the router in VTR reads each image region across several previous screenshots and is trained jointly with the language model, so the model learns to act from the kept tokens, and the number of kept tokens is not set in advance but chosen so that the model does not lose accuracy.

blocks.en: As computer-use agents improve on benchmarks such as OSWorld [ Xie et al., 2024 ] , recent work has turned to their speed and cost. OSWorld-Human [ Abhyankar et al., 2026 ] finds that agents take tens of minutes on tasks that humans complete in a few minutes, with later steps taking up to three times longer than early ones, and cua-speedrun [ Aggarwal et al., 2026a ] standardizes the infrastructure for measuring the speed and cost of agents across benchmarks. In real-time domains, VideoGameBench [ Zhang et al., 2025a ] identifies inference latency as a major limitation of frontier models in video games, and in Gym-Anything-RT [ Aggarwal and Welleck, 2026 ] , the pass rate of a frontier agent rises from 9.0% to 75.0% when the environment is paused while the agent decides. To limit the cost of screenshots, agents commonly keep only the last few screenshots in context and represent earlier steps as text [ Qin et al., 2025 , Wang et al., 2025a ] , and Anthropic recommends reducing the resolution of screenshots and keeping only the most recent ones [ Anthropic, 2026 ] . Methods designed for GUI agents reduce tokens more selectively. ShowUI [ Lin et al., 2025 ] groups patches of similar color into connected components and skips part of the patches in each component, GUIPruner [ Xu et al., 2026 ] lowers the resolution of older screenshots and prunes the current one with rules that preserve its layout, GUI-KV [ Huang et al., 2026 ] compresses the key-value cache by scoring how redundant older screenshots are given the current one, and SimpAgent [ Chen et al., 2025 ] trains the model to drop all history screenshots after a fixed layer. STP-GUI [ Wang et al., 2026b ] learns a token selector with reinforcement learning, but keeps the model frozen and keeps a fixed fraction of tokens. However, none of these methods learns which tokens to keep together with the model that predicts actions. ReVision [ Abaskohi et al., 2026 ] comes closest to our work. A three-layer MLP compares each patch with the same patch in the previous screenshot and drops unchanged patches, the first screenshot in the window is kept in full, and kept patches retain their original positions. However, ReVision trains its MLP on labels obtained by matching regions from a UI parser across screenshots, and only then fine-tunes the model on the filtered trajectories, so the MLP detects unchanged content rather than learning what the agent needs for its next action. In contrast, VTR starts its router from similar labels, which combine changed regions with segmented objects (§ 2.3 ), and then trains the router jointly with the model to preserve action prediction, on desktop tasks and video games.
blocks.zh: 随着计算机使用代理人改进了OSWorld等基准[Xie等,2024],近期的工作转向了速度和成本. OS World-Human [Abhyankar等,2026]发现特工在几分钟内完成人类完成的任务需要数十分钟时间,后来的步骤比早期步骤要多出3倍多,而cua-speedrun[Aggarwal等,2026a]将测量特工跨基准速度和成本的基础设施标准化. 在实时领域,VideoGame Bench [Zhang等,2025a]确定推论延迟是电子游戏中前沿模型的主要限制,在Gym-Anything-RT [Aggarwal and Welleck,2026]中,当代理商决定时环境暂停时,前沿代理商的通过率从9.0%上升到75.0%. 为了限制截图的成本,特工们通常只保留上下文中最后几张截图,并代表了更早的步骤作为文本[秦等,2025年;王等,2025年a];而Anthropic则建议降低截图的解析度并只保留最近期的[Anthropic,2026]. 为GUI代理设计的方法更有选择性地减少信使. STP-GUI [Wang等,2026b]学习有强化学习的符号选择器,但保持了模型被冷冻并保留了一定比例的符号. 然而,这些方法中没有任何一种方法能够知道哪些表示与预测行动的模式保持一致。 展望[Abaskohi等,2026]最接近我们的工作。 一个三层的 MLP 将上个截图中的每个补丁与相同的补丁进行比较,并放下不变的补丁,窗口中的第一个截图被完整地保存,并保持补丁保留了原来的位置. 然而,Revision在从一个UI解析器从截图上取出匹配区域获得的标签上对它的MLP进行训练,而后才对被过滤出轨迹上的模型进行微调,因此MLP检测到内容不变,而不是学习代理对其下个动作需要什么. 相形之下,VTR从类似的标签开始其路由器,这些标签将已改变的区域与被分割的对象(§ 2.3)相结合,然后与模型一起对路由器进行培训以保存动作预测,进行桌面任务和电子游戏.

blocks.en: Conditional computation trains a router to decide which parts of a network process each input. Sparsely gated mixture-of-experts models route each token to its top-scoring experts [ Shazeer et al., 2017 , Fedus et al., 2022 ] , expert choice routing lets each expert pick a fixed number of tokens [ Zhou et al., 2022 ] , and Mixture-of-Depths [ Raposo et al., 2024 ] applies the same idea across layers, sending a fixed number of tokens through each block while the rest skip it. In these models, the router’s weight scales the output, which gives the router a gradient despite the discrete choice, while other methods train discrete gates with the straight-through estimator [ Bengio et al., 2013 ] or with continuous relaxations such as Gumbel-softmax [ Jang et al., 2017 , Maddison et al., 2017 ] . Adaptive computation methods let the amount of computation vary across inputs, by learning when to stop computing under a penalty on the amount of computation [ Graves, 2016 , Yin et al., 2022 ] , or by activating a variable number of experts [ Wang et al., 2025b , Guo et al., 2025 ] , where ReMoE [ Wang et al., 2025b ] adapts the weight of its sparsity penalty to reach a target average sparsity. Separately, constrained optimization replaces hand-tuned loss weights with Lagrange multipliers that are adapted during training to meet a target, as in constrained VAEs [ Rezende and Viola, 2018 ] , constrained reinforcement learning [ Altman, 1999 , Tessler et al., 2019 , Stooke et al., 2020 ] , and pruning to a target sparsity [ Wang et al., 2020 , Xia et al., 2022 , Gallego-Posada et al., 2022 ] . However, methods that reduce computation fix its amount, set a target for it, or weight it with a hand-tuned penalty, so they do not ensure that the model keeps its accuracy. CALM [ Schuster et al., 2022 ] comes closest to our work, letting each token exit the language model early and calibrating the exit thresholds after training so that, with high probability, the outputs stay close to those of the full model. In contrast, VTR minimizes the number of kept tokens subject to the model not losing accuracy, measured against reference models with and without the full history, and enforces this constraint during training by dual ascent. Like mixture-of-experts models, VTR scales each kept token by its keep probability, but it removes dropped tokens from the input entirely, so they cost no computation in any layer.

Zhou等, 2022]),而Mixture-of-Depths [Raposo等, 2024] 将同一想法跨层应用,通过每个区块发送固定的代币数量,而其余则跳过. 在这些模型中,路由器的权重对输出进行分级,尽管有离散选择,这还是给路由器一个梯度,而其他方法则会用直通估计器[Bengio等,2013年]或如"Gumbel-softmax"(Jang等,2017年;Maddison等,2017年]等持续放松来训练离散门. 适应性计算方法使计算量因投入而异,方法是学会何时停止计算,对计算量进行处罚[Graves, 2016, Yin等, 2022], 或激活数量可变的专家[。 Wang等, 2025b., Guo等, 2025],其中ReMoE [Wang等, 2025b] 调整了它的痉挛处罚的重量以达到目标平均痉挛. 另外,受限优化将手调减重取而代之的是训练期间为达到目标而调整的拉格兰克乘数,如受限的VAEs [Rezende and Viola, 2018],受限的强化学习 [Altman, 1999, Tessler等, 2019, Stooke等, 2020],并挤入到目标痉挛中去[. Wang等, 2020., Xia等, 2022., Gallego-Posada等, 2022] (中文(简体) ). 然而,减少计算的方法固定了它的金额,为其设定了目标,或者用手调的处罚来加权,因此不能保证模型保持它的准确性. CALM[Shuster等,2022]最接近于我们的工作,让每个信使提前从语言模型中退出,并在训练后校准出场阈值,以便高概率的输出能接近全模型. 相形之下,VTR将保留在模型上且不失去准确度的代币数量减少到最低程度,参照有完整历史和没有完整历史的参照模型进行测量,并在训练期间通过双升来强制执行这一约束. 与专家混合模型一样,VTR平面图按其保持概率保留了符号,但从输入中完全去除掉的符号,因此在任何一层中都不计算成本.
